core_demonstration.policy: Separate available-use and single-cycle progress accounts; explicit atomic completion fills the former and resets the latter. Partial progress cannot pay a use.
core_demonstration.ability_route: AbilityDefinition.recharge_resource now separates slot-based gains from usable cost energy; original Pugilist, Wellspring and Surplus definitions compose with the synthetic linked ability. Already-full usable accounts reject further routed progress.

equipment_cycle_yield.policy: One persistent uses/progress pair supports both sequential and linked completion. A completion-time Profile changes optional complete_recharge.amount from one to the current missing uses; physical equipment changes retain progress. Capacity is independent.
equipment_cycle_yield.boundary: Generic source/Buff composition and actual equipment proof only. Does not establish original Ophidia equip/reset or recent-use behavior; no automatic migration of legacy single-account abilities.

selected_capacity.policy: Resolve the current base selection at execution and resize its usable cost account only. Empty, costless and fixed-capacity selections return distinct nonnumeric outcomes before evaluating capacity. The separate recharge meter and unselected accounts are unchanged.
selected_capacity.composition: Synthetic SOURCE and selection rules read the final source set, preserve balance on equivalent physical equipment replacement, and recompute retained accounts when reselected. Delayed actions use the selection at execution; temporary cast replacements do not redirect capacity.
selected_capacity.boundary: Generic engine capability only; the synthetic 2/3 capacities, 0.5/s cycle and healing observations do not implement or calibrate Ophidia Spathe.

unresolved: Recent-use exception duration and exact original-game cycle/reset behavior remain uncalibrated.
The fixture is not Ophidia Spathe, Gambler dodge or a Solar knife. No Compendium entry is promoted by it.
Arbitrary linked groups, parallel independent progress lanes, migration, persistence and UI are not implemented.
